claims.summary: Michaelis classifies the Brazilian Portuguese entry muito as adjective, pronoun, noun and adverb.
Michaelis records muito as an adverb for high degree before adjectives/adverbs and for quantity, with the quoted examples.
The DLE describes muy as a reduced form of mucho and an adverb before noncomparative adjectives/adverbs, with the quoted examples.
The DLE records mucho as an indefinite adjective, pronoun, and adverb and provides the quoted examples.
The cited entries document functional correspondences but do not claim automatic translation of every occurrence of muito as muy or mucho.
